name: Kenneth Barry
bio:
Kenneth Barry is an Irish actor and producer based in Limerick. Known for his dynamic screen presence, he has appeared in prominent television dramas and feature films, including featured roles in RTÉ’s **Crimecall**, **Hidden Assets**, and **Blackshore**. His expanding filmography includes notable roles in **Bonhoeffer**, **I Fear the Man I’ve Become**, and the highly anticipated feature **4 Kids Walk into a Bank**, starring Liam Neeson and Jennifer Grey.

Beyond his work in front of the camera, Kenneth is an active producer. He spearheaded the **Come Dine with Us Christmas Special**, collaborating with prominent Irish content creators Aisling Unfiltered, Shane McCarthy, Josephine Duffy, and Sam McCarthy to raise crucial funds and awareness for breast cancer.

Kenneth continues to explore diverse creative projects across the Irish arts landscape. He recently featured in King Kong Company's music video for their track **"Corfu,"** featuring Bobby Fingers. He also portrays the role of Gother in the upcoming musical feature film **Drummer Boy**, filmed on location in Ireland alongside the Smallbone brothers (Ben, Luke, and Joel Smallbone).

credits.title: Drummer Boy
credits.overview: As America’s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family search for freedom. Through battle and loss, music carries hope in a deeply human story of faith and forgiveness.

credits.title: I Stared The Devil In The Eye
credits.overview: Three seemingly unconnected lives become intertwined through a series of  unexpected events, forcing each person to confront the consequences of their choices. As the truth begins to surface, everything changes in ways they never saw coming.

credits.title: Work Friends
credits.overview: A small time criminal is tasked with killing a rat…whom he just so happens to share a past with.

credits.title: Thomas’ Promotion
credits.overview: Upon finding his brother’s girlfriend deceased in the shower, Lex desperately tries to hide the body before his brothers promotion party. Things get worse when he reveals his plans to propose.

credits.title: Once Upon a Time in a Cinema
credits.overview: Earl Clancy, a cinema owner on the edge, battles a series of disasters while juggling personal turmoil and the chaos of a packed Friday night crowd. Told in real time over the course of the movie playing in the cinema (Breathless, starring Richard Gere).

credits.title: The Debt Collectors Son
credits.overview: A debt collector brings his son, an aspiring artist, along on a job in the hopes of making a man out of him.

credits.title: No Snakes in Ireland
credits.overview: A young woman looking to forget her troubled past and conform to the world begins hearing snakes in her home on Halloween.

credits.title: I Fear The Man I’ve Become
credits.overview: John, a young man struggling with the death of his brother, looks to get revenge on the men who took him out. But as the lies build up, the true identity of his brothers killer becomes more and more difficult to grasp.

credits.title: The Moment Before
credits.overview: In Dublin, a restless teenager and a mysterious woman cross paths by chance. What starts as an ordinary conversation soon reveals hidden truths, forcing them to confront their deepest fears and regrets. In a single, unexpected moment, their lives may change forever. The Moment Before.

credits.title: Bonhoeffer: Pastor. Spy. Assassin
credits.overview: As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, Dietrich Bonhoeffer joins a deadly plot to assassinate Hitler, risking his faith and fate to save millions of Jews from genocide.
